Statement_Text: Every employee uses two-step sign-in for email and the file server.
Unattended laptops must lock their screens within five minutes.
The finance share is copied off-site every night.
Anyone who notices a phishing message forwards it to the help desk at once.
The cloud payroll vendor completed our supplier questionnaire before onboarding.
Guests wait at reception until a host collects them.
Pull requests need one approving review before they are merged.
New starters finish the security basics module in their first week.
Restore drills for the customer database are run every three months.
Mobile phones issued by the company have full-disk encryption switched on.
The canteen menu changes every Monday.
Release candidates go through automated tests on a staging server.
